---
title: "`r if (!is.null(params$qa)) paste(params$qa$settings$study, params$qa$settings$visit) else 'Luminex'` cell-culture pre-repeats QA"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y, %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
    toc_depth: 2
    self_contained: true
    mathjax: null
    fig_retina: 1
params:
  qa: NULL
  master_file: ""
  sheet: "for master"
  hsp60: TRUE
  r848: TRUE
  il10: FALSE
  max_detail: 1000
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center", dev = "png", dpi = 120)
library(ggplot2)

qa <- params$qa
if (is.null(qa)) {
  if (!nzchar(params$master_file)) stop("Set `master_file` in the YAML header, or call fhrc::luminex_qa_report().")
  qa <- fhrc::luminex_qa(params$master_file, sheet = params$sheet,
                         hsp60 = params$hsp60, r848 = params$r848, il10 = params$il10)
}
S <- qa$settings
an <- S$analytes
sm <- qa$summary

# ---- palette ------------------------------------------------------------------
ink <- "#0b0b0b"; ink2 <- "#52514e"; muted <- "#898781"; grid_col <- "#e1e0d9"; surface <- "#fcfcfb"
analyte_cols <- stats::setNames(c("#2a78d6", "#eb6834", "#1baf7a", "#eda100", "#e87ba4", "#008300")[seq_along(an)], an)
flag_col <- "#d03b3b"; context_grey <- "#c3c2b7"

theme_set(
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) %+replace%
    theme(text = element_text(colour = ink2),
          plot.background = element_rect(fill = surface, colour = NA),
          panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = grid_col, linewidth = 0.3),
          panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(colour = ink, face = "bold", size = 11, margin = margin(4, 0, 4, 0)),
          axis.text = element_text(colour = muted),
          legend.position = "top", legend.justification = "left",
          plot.title.position = "plot"))

# ---- helpers ------------------------------------------------------------------
tbl <- function(d, ...) {
  if (is.null(d) || !nrow(d)) return(cat("<p class='none'>None found.</p>\n"))
  cat(knitr::kable(d, format = "html", row.names = FALSE, escape = TRUE,
                   table.attr = "class='table table-condensed qa'", ...))
}
none <- function(msg = "None found.") cat("<p class='none'>", msg, "</p>\n")
show_plot <- function(p) {
  if (is.null(p)) return(invisible())
  tryCatch(print(p), error = function(e)
    cat("<p class='note'>Plot skipped: ", htmltools::htmlEscape(conditionMessage(e)), "</p>\n"))
}
spread_log <- function(y, by) {           # keep flagged-id labels from overlapping
  out <- y
  for (g in unique(by)) {
    i <- which(by == g)
    ly <- log10(y[i]); gap <- 0.09 * max(diff(range(ly)), 1)
    o <- order(ly); ys <- ly[o]
    for (k in seq_along(ys)[-1]) if (ys[k] - ys[k - 1] < gap) ys[k] <- ys[k - 1] + gap
    ly[o] <- ys; out[i] <- 10^ly
  }
  out
}
fmt <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","))
short_plate <- function(x) sub("\\.xlsx$", "", x)

cond_order <- local({
  stims <- unique(S$contrasts$higher[S$contrasts$lower == "us"])
  inhib <- unlist(lapply(S$dose_series, function(s) names(sort(s$doses))))
  base <- unique(c("us", setdiff(stims, "lps"), "lps", inhib))
  c(intersect(base, S$expected_conditions), setdiff(S$expected_conditions, base))
})
idnum <- function(x) suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("_.*$", "", x)))
pos_plot <- local({
  stims <- setdiff(unique(S$contrasts$higher[S$contrasts$lower == "us"]), "lps")
  stims <- intersect(stims, S$expected_conditions)
  out <- data.frame(condition = stims, x = seq_along(stims), line = NA_character_, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  xx <- length(stims)
  blocks <- lapply(S$dose_series, function(s) c(s$reference, names(sort(s$doses))))
  if (!length(blocks) && "lps" %in% S$expected_conditions) blocks <- list(lps = "lps")
  for (nm in names(blocks)) {
    cs <- blocks[[nm]]
    if (xx > 0) xx <- xx + 0.5                                 # small gap between groups
    out <- rbind(out, data.frame(condition = cs, x = xx + seq_along(cs), line = nm, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
    xx <- xx + length(cs)
  }
  out
})
is_pid <- grepl("^[0-9]+(_V[0-9]+)?$", sm$participant)
all_ids <- unique(sm$participant[is_pid])
file_issues <- c("set-up", "unreadable id", "duplicated data", "unknown condition", "different study prefix", "missing data", "plate")
dose_label <- "dose-response dip/spike"
pr <- qa$plates
if (is.null(pr) || !is.data.frame(pr)) pr <- data.frame()
inhib_fold <- unique(S$contrasts$fold[S$contrasts$lower != "us"])
tagged_ids <- unique(sm$participant[is_pid & !sm$issue %in% file_issues])
tagged_ids <- tagged_ids[order(idnum(tagged_ids), tagged_ids)]
ld <- qa$low_dose
jic_ids <- unique(ld$participant)
jic_also_tagged <- intersect(jic_ids, tagged_ids)
jic_ids <- setdiff(jic_ids, tagged_ids)
jic_ids <- jic_ids[order(idnum(jic_ids), jic_ids)]
```

if (length(not_indicated)) {
  lst <- if (length(not_indicated) == 1) not_indicated else
    paste0(paste(not_indicated[-length(not_indicated)], collapse = ", "), " and ", not_indicated[length(not_indicated)])

# Summary

```{r summary, results = "asis"}
if (!nrow(sm)) {
  none("None found.")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("<p>%d problem%s across %d participant%s.</p>\n",
              nrow(sm), if (nrow(sm) == 1) "" else "s",
              length(all_ids), if (length(all_ids) == 1) "" else "s"))
  iss <- unique(sm$issue)
  iss <- iss[order(fhrc:::.lqa_issue_rank(iss, S), iss)]
  tbl(data.frame(issue = iss, participants = vapply(iss, function(i) length(unique(sm$participant[sm$issue == i])), 1L),
                 stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
}
if (nrow(pr)) {
  np <- length(unique(pr$plate))
  cat(sprintf("<p>%d plate%s with the same problem in %d or more participants in a row: see <b>Plates</b>.</p>\n",
              np, if (np == 1) "" else "s", S$plate_run))
}
```

# Missing & data entry

## Missing wells and values

```{r missing, results = "asis"}
m <- qa$missing
if (!nrow(m)) {
  none("None found.")
} else {
  m$what <- ifelse(m$issue == "condition missing", paste0(m$condition, " missing"),
                   ifelse(m$issue == "value missing", paste0(m$condition, ": ", m$analyte, " blank"), m$issue))
  g <- stats::aggregate(what ~ id_num, m, function(z) paste(z, collapse = "; "))
  g <- g[order(idnum(g$id_num), g$id_num), ]
  tbl(g, col.names = c("id", "missing"))
}
```

issues <- rbind(

# Stimulation & inhibition order

Stimulated wells should have more cytokines than US. Similarly, `r if ("il10" %in% names(S$dose_series)) "cortisol and IL-10 wells" else "cortisol wells"` should have less than LPS alone; `r if ("il10" %in% names(S$dose_series)) "one of these wells" else "a cortisol well"` is counted only when it is more than `r paste(inhib_fold, collapse = "/")`x the LPS well. The table below counts participants not conforming to these two patterns.

```{r counts, results = "asis"}
cmp <- qa$contrasts
if (!nrow(cmp)) none("None found.") else {
  tests <- S$contrasts$test
  ct <- sapply(an, function(a) sapply(tests, function(t) sum(cmp$flag[cmp$test == t & cmp$analyte == a])))
  ct <- matrix(ct, nrow = length(tests), dimnames = list(tests, an))
  any_n <- sapply(tests, function(t) length(unique(cmp$id_num[cmp$test == t & cmp$flag])))
  d <- data.frame(check = tests,
                  as.data.frame(ct, check.names = FALSE), `any cytokine` = any_n,
                  note = ifelse(S$contrasts$tier == "sensitive", "can typically ignore", ""),
                  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  tbl(d)
}
```

Plots below show each participant as a line, red ones are the ones that got tagged as breaking the pattern above.

```{r slope_fun}
slope_plot <- function(d) {
  d <- d[!is.na(d$higher_value) & !is.na(d$lower_value) & d$higher_value > 0 & d$lower_value > 0, ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  lv <- c(d$lower[1], d$higher[1])
  long <- rbind(data.frame(id_num = d$id_num, analyte = d$analyte, well = lv[1], value = d$lower_value, flag = d$flag),
                data.frame(id_num = d$id_num, analyte = d$analyte, well = lv[2], value = d$higher_value, flag = d$flag))
  long$well <- factor(long$well, levels = lv)
  long$grp <- paste(long$id_num, long$analyte)
  lab <- long[long$flag & long$well == lv[2], ]
  if (nrow(lab)) lab$value <- spread_log(lab$value, lab$analyte)
  ggplot(long, aes(well, value, group = grp)) +
    geom_line(data = long[!long$flag, ], colour = context_grey, linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_line(data = long[long$flag, ], colour = flag_col, linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = long[long$flag, ], colour = flag_col, size = 1.8) +
    geom_text(data = lab, aes(label = id_num), colour = flag_col, size = 3, hjust = -0.25) +
    scale_y_log10(labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE)) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.25, 0.55))) +
    facet_wrap(~ analyte, nrow = 1) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = paste(S$measure, "(log scale)"))
}
```

# Dose-response

Values shown as ln(MFI + 1). Dose 0 is the LPS-only well.

Only participants who are not already tagged in Stimulation & inhibition order are listed and drawn in red here. A participant is tagged when one well dips far below (or spikes far above) both of its neighbouring doses in at least `r S$dip_cytokines` cytokines.

```{r dose_response, results = "asis", fig.height = 3.8, fig.width = 10}
ds <- qa$dose
di <- qa$dose_issues
dp <- qa$dose_points
stim_issue <- !sm$issue %in% c(file_issues, dose_label)
tagged_above <- unique(sm$participant[stim_issue])
if (!length(S$dose_series) || !length(ds) || !nrow(ds)) {
  none("None found.")
} else {
  for (nm in names(S$dose_series)) {
    cat("\n\n## ", nm, "\n\n", sep = "")
    d_nm <- di[di$series == nm & !di$id_num %in% tagged_above, ]
    ids <- unique(d_nm$id_num)
    v <- dp[dp$series == nm & !is.na(dp$score), ]
    if (!nrow(v)) { none("None found."); next }
    steps <- unique(dp[dp$series == nm, c("step", "condition")])
    steps <- steps[order(steps$step), ]
    v$hl <- v$id_num %in% ids
    v <- v[order(v$step), ]
    last <- v[v$hl, ]
    last <- last[!duplicated(paste(last$id_num, last$analyte), fromLast = TRUE), ]
    if (nrow(last)) for (a in unique(last$analyte)) {      # nudge labels apart
      i <- which(last$analyte == a); y <- last$score[i]; gap <- 0.06 * diff(range(v$score))
      o <- order(y); ys <- y[o]
      for (k in seq_along(ys)[-1]) if (ys[k] - ys[k - 1] < gap) ys[k] <- ys[k - 1] + gap
      y[o] <- ys; last$score[i] <- y
    }
    show_plot(
      ggplot(v, aes(step, score, group = id_num)) +
        geom_line(data = v[!v$hl, ], colour = context_grey, linewidth = 0.45, alpha = 0.8) +
        geom_line(data = v[v$hl, ], colour = flag_col, linewidth = 0.9) +
        geom_point(data = v[v$hl, ], colour = flag_col, size = 1.8) +
        geom_text(data = last, aes(label = id_num), colour = flag_col, size = 3, hjust = -0.3) +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = steps$step, labels = paste0(steps$step, "\n", steps$condition),
                           expand = expansion(add = c(0.3, 1.1))) +
        facet_wrap(~ analyte, nrow = 1) +
        labs(x = "dose", y = "ln(MFI + 1)"))
    if (!length(ids)) { none("None found."); next }
    d_nm <- d_nm[order(idnum(d_nm$id_num), d_nm$id_num), ]
    tbl(d_nm[, c("id_num", "text")], col.names = c("id", "dose-response issue"))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

# Plates

```{r plates, results = "asis"}
if (!nrow(pr)) {
  none("None found.")
} else {
  cat(sprintf("<p class='note'>Listed when %d or more participants next to each other on the same plate (in id order) have the same problem.</p>\n",
              S$plate_run))
  for (p in unique(pr$plate)) {
    r <- pr[pr$plate == p, ]
    parts <- vapply(unique(r$participants), function(ps) {
      k <- r$participants == ps
      sprintf("%d participants in a row (%s) have %s", r$n[k][1], ps, paste(r$issue[k], collapse = ", "))
    }, "")
    cat(sprintf("<p><b>%s</b>: %s. Please investigate.</p>\n", htmltools::htmlEscape(short_plate(p)),
                htmltools::htmlEscape(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))))
  }
}
```

# Tagged participants

```{r detail_intro, results = "asis"}
ids_show <- utils::head(tagged_ids, params$max_detail)
if (!length(tagged_ids)) none("None found.")
```

```{r detail, results = "asis", fig.height = 3.3, fig.width = 10}
panel <- function(p, issues, details) {
  v <- qa$values[qa$values$id_num == p, ]
  cat("\n\n## ", p, " {.participant}\n\n", sep = "")
  if (nrow(v)) cat(sprintf("<p class='note'>Plate: %s</p>\n", htmltools::htmlEscape(short_plate(v$plate[1]))))
  cat("<ul>", paste0("<li><b>", htmltools::htmlEscape(issues), ":</b> ",
                     htmltools::htmlEscape(details), "</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>\n", sep = "")
  if (!nrow(v)) return(invisible())
  lv <- c(cond_order, setdiff(unique(v$condition), cond_order))
  if (nrow(pos_plot) && any(!is.na(v$mfi))) {
    pv <- merge(expand.grid(condition = pos_plot$condition, analyte = an, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
                v[, c("condition", "analyte", "mfi")], all.x = TRUE)
    pv <- pv[!duplicated(pv[, c("condition", "analyte")]), ]
    pv <- merge(pos_plot, pv, by = "condition")             # a reference well shown twice gets both positions
    pv <- pv[order(pv$analyte, pv$x), ]
    us <- v[v$condition == "us" & !is.na(v$mfi), c("analyte", "mfi")]
    us$x <- max(pos_plot$x) + 0.45
    many <- nrow(pos_plot) > 7
    show_plot(
      ggplot(pv, aes(x, mfi, colour = analyte)) +
        geom_hline(data = us, aes(yintercept = mfi, colour = analyte), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
        geom_text(data = us, aes(x = x, y = mfi, label = "US"), colour = ink2, size = 3, vjust = -0.4) +
        geom_line(data = pv[!is.na(pv$line) & !is.na(pv$mfi), ], aes(group = interaction(analyte, line)), linewidth = 0.9) +
        geom_point(data = pv[!is.na(pv$mfi), ], size = 2.4, shape = 21, fill = surface, stroke = 0.7) +
        scale_colour_manual(values = analyte_cols, guide = "none") +
        scale_x_continuous(breaks = pos_plot$x, labels = pos_plot$condition,
                           limits = c(min(pos_plot$x) - 0.3, max(pos_plot$x) + 0.7)) +
        scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
                           expand = expansion(mult = c(0.03, 0.12))) +
        expand_limits(y = 0) +
        facet_wrap(~ analyte, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
        labs(x = NULL, y = "MFI") +
        theme(axis.text.x = if (many) element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1) else element_text()))
  } else cat("<p class='note'>No values for this participant.</p>\n")
  conds <- unique(v$condition)
  conds <- conds[order(match(conds, lv))]
  get <- function(a, what) {
    r <- v[v$analyte == a, ]
    r[match(conds, r$condition), what]
  }
  conc_txt <- function(a) {               # numbers as numbers; keep text such as "OOR >" as is
    raw <- trimws(as.character(get(a, "conc_raw")))
    num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(raw))
    ifelse(is.na(raw) | raw == "", "", ifelse(is.na(num), raw, fmt(num, 2)))
  }
  w <- data.frame(condition = conds, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  for (a in an) w[[paste(a, "MFI")]] <- fmt(get(a, "mfi"), 0)
  for (a in an) w[[paste(a, "conc")]] <- conc_txt(a)
  for (a in an) w[[paste(a, "CV%")]] <- fmt(get(a, "cv"), 1)
  tbl(w)
}
for (p in ids_show) {
  items <- sm[sm$participant == p, ]
  panel(p, items$issue, items$detail)
}
```
